description: This file contains unit tests for the TextReader class within the core module, specifically testing the reading of a text fragment from a data element.

classes.name: TextReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading text data from a DataElement, supports resetting and reading lines.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the TextReader to its initial state, ready to read again.

methods.name: ReadLine
methods.description: Reads the next line of text from the input data, returning a TextFragment.

methods.name: EndOfText
methods.description: Checks if the reader has reached the end of the text.
